name: Code of Silence
source:
Detective Katherine Reeves's faith in her friend is tested when evidence links brilliant tech founder Aiden Yates to a series of mob-related cyber crimes.

[From [url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/code-of-silence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当确凿证据将才华横溢的科技公司创始人艾登·耶茨与一连串涉黑网络犯罪联系在一起时，警探凯瑟琳·里夫斯对挚友的信任迎来了严峻考验。

[摘自[url=https://visualnovelsai.itch.io/code-of-silence]itch.io[/url]]
